pivot_recommendation: At least one axis reaches three diseases with compartment-plausible raw positive signal and direction-stable residual support.
decision_rule: A disease supports an axis if one compartment-plausible module has raw positive p<=0.10, all available residual deltas remain positive across at least four covariates, at least one covariate residual remains nominal positive p<=0.10, and median residual Hedges g>=0.5.
